name: Verascope — Page Quality & QA Suite
description: Seven QA tools in one popup: check meta title/description against target SEO copy, overlay alt text on images with an Excel validation report, extract all page links/images to Excel, open cache-busted URLs in bulk, run automated semantic-aware form field QA with a 5-sheet Excel report, crawl a page for broken/redirected/slow links and export a formatted Excel report, and audit every font on a page with live hover inspection and a styled Excel font report.
